source_text:
Barcelona have reached an agreement in principle worth €76.5million (£65.3m; $87.8m) with Manchester City for the transfer of Rodri.
                    On August 6 Barcelona were exploring a deal for Rodri, and the 30-year-old preferred a move to Camp Nou over any other club.
                    Barcelona's rival, Real Madrid had also been exploring a move for the Spain captain this summer, but Rodri preferred to sign for Barcelona.
                    Rodri has been a key player for Manchester City since joining from Atletico Madrid in 2019, and he has won two Premier League titles with the club.
                    The midfielder has also been a regular for Spain, winning the 2020 European Championship, the 2022 Nations League and the 2026 World Cup.
                    Rodri won the 2023 Ballon d'Or, and he is considered one of the best midfielders in the world.
                    For Barcelona, the signing of Rodri is a major coup, and it will strengthen their midfield as they look to challenge for the La Liga title and the Champions League.
